subtitle: Toronto's largest beach, run under a food-and-alcohol concession one family has held for two decades and counting.
spike_statement: One family has held exclusive, bid-free rights to sell food and alcohol on Woodbine Beach for 20+ years, renewed by council for 20 more.

levers.photo_tone: A working-class Toronto beach in flat daylight: packed sand, volleyball nets, and the lake stretching south with the city at its back
